reviewNotes: Separate AI editorial review of all 38 original B1/B2 noun questions: checked full German sentences, article/case/weak inflection, all four options per variant, single accepted answer, distinct contexts, bilingual hints and feedback, source provenance. Corrected die Dose (source erroneously 'das'), Dozent masculine example/dative, Druck plural ambiguity and manual fire-alarm terminology; deferred Doktorin due to ambiguous occupational/title sense. No inherited examples copied. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval remain pending.
